decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-010-RAW-EXP-001-01: “metadata-only export remains available” in the same owned-retained-recording/no-export-approval state: positive HTTP metadata test has a different fixture; no same-context metadata-only request assertion.; OTGD-010-RAW-EXP-003-01: “without creating a raw job”: no raw HTTP request with existing recording consent but absent separate notice/confirmation followed by DB job-count/state assertion. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-011-OPERATOR-AUTHORITY-001-02: “receipt exposes revision one, exact normalized body ... replay ... without ... second submission decision”: no initial receipt revision/body equality or post-replay event-count assertion; actor uses fictional local identity, not actual cloud authentication.; OTGD-011-OPERATOR-AUTHORITY-002-02: “accepted history contains exact request identity and reason for each decision”; no per-event identity/reason comparison. Three named authenticated cloud duties are not integrated through CLI; actual cloud credentials/role exercise is external. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-020-AND-ENV-001-01: “both run on one phone ... distinct identities/local namespaces and QA visibly labeled”: no co-installed QA+prod native execution or same-phone namespace/UI observation. Build-source declarations and dev infrastructure templates are not this phone scenario.; OTGD-020-AND-ENV-002-01: “usable encrypted store ... configuration request times out ... offline state and no fabricated server result”: controller test uses runtime memory store and immediate thrown fetch, not bounded timeout with retained encrypted data; it does not assert offline flag or absence of fabricated SERVER result. Guest fictional simulation is explicitly separate. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

decisions.previous_provisional_source_review_obser: Signed HMAC cursor binds account/environment/issuer/generation/fixed sort and actual unchanged owned row; strict parsing and concurrent-insert tests are meaningful. No distinct cursor defect established. Client invalid-cursor/native history acceptance still requires current execution.

criteria: AND-SYNC-001 Persist before announcing save
AND-SYNC-002 Require explicit authorized upload
AND-SYNC-003 Use stable idempotent operations
AND-SYNC-004 Isolate users and environments
AND-SYNC-005 Reconcile stale revisions without overwrite
AND-SYNC-006 Bound retries and preserve terminal failures
AND-SYNC-007 Preserve scientific and acquisition time
external_limits: Actual native OS/device/lifecycle/assistive/encrypted-storage qualification where applicable remains separate.
Hardware/electrical/assay/scientific/study approvals and genuine cloud/store deployment evidence are not created by fictional software tests.
decisions.decision_scope: Independent CODE IMPLEMENTATION review of this canonical spec; not council/global app/release approval.
decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-029-AND-SYNC-001-01: Actual installed native encrypted database process restart, successful save message and same-record reopen are not executed; controlled storage backend is not SQLCipher/OS evidence.; OTGD-029-AND-SYNC-001-02: No direct finished-check encrypted-write/DISK_FULL failure assertion verifies no success message, no queued nonexistent check and recoverable unchanged draft together. Native raw rollback/terminal handoff failures concern different operations. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-036-AND-SET-001-01: Settings itself must expose Sign in and cloud-deletion account-requirement wording while local clear remains reachable; current guest journey asserts Delete account absent, not every signed-out Settings item.; OTGD-036-AND-SET-001-02: Active native workspace switch before decision, explicit cannot-resume wording, ended once and no cross-workspace record move is not asserted end-to-end; browser draft is fictional nonactive task. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-037-AND-AUTH-001-01: The actual production public-client hosted browser and native callback account journey remains unexecuted. Current endpoint pinning, exact returned target, code/state, replay, refresh and no credential traffic on refusal are directly tested; Cognito/provider credentials and installed OS execution are separate prerequisites.; OTGD-037-AND-AUTH-001-02: Production build with local fixture token via tampered saved credentials/callback and unchanged current account inventory is not directly asserted. Arbitrary wrong issuer case differs from explicit production/local issuer namespace injection. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

criteria: PAI-001 Release exact bounded participant instructions
PAI-002 Bind an immutable acknowledgment to current scope
PAI-003 Re-admit instructions at every fresh start
PAI-004 Distinguish declarations from measured safety proof
PAI-005 Preserve acknowledgment retry and replacement identity
PAI-006 Stop before privacy and lifecycle transitions
PAI-007 Show capability and provenance truthfully
PAI-008 Guide declared cardiac rest without clock shortcuts
external_limits: Actual native OS/device/lifecycle/assistive/encrypted-storage qualification where applicable remains separate.
Hardware/electrical/assay/scientific/study approvals and genuine cloud/store deployment evidence are not created by fictional software tests.
decisions.decision_scope: Independent CODE IMPLEMENTATION review of this canonical spec; not council/global app/release approval.
decisions.rationale: Independent current source and executed-evidence review finds no open demonstrated code defect; required seven local and14CI gates now pass. IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-039-PAI-001-01: exact approved rest/posture/contact instruction text and version are displayed without defaults: existing assertions inspect controls/protocol digest rather than all rendered text/version.; OTGD-039-PAI-002-02: refusal for each foreign account/generation/study/config receipt at acquisition without rewriting scope/time: entire cross-product not asserted at receipt-admission boundary. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

IMPLEMENTATION acceptance remains blocked by exact residual clauses, including OTGD-041-EVAL-002-02: explicit removal of invalid/abstaining output rows or different submitted ablation row membership is refused: negative report row-removal mutations are not directly asserted.; OTGD-041-EVAL-002-03: CLI outputs are explicitly engineering_synthetic/unvalidated with authority flags false. Reviewed deployment maintenance dispatch invokes resource bootstrap, migration and recovery admission, not a study/model fixture seed. No executed negative attempts to admit the exact generated engineering artifact as a human-approved deployed model were located; factual absence of a configured real study is not scientific approval. Full exact residuals are retained below; software gaps and external prerequisites are distinguished.

unproved_then_clauses: explicit removal of invalid/abstaining output rows or different submitted ablation row membership is refused: negative report row-removal mutations are not directly asserted.
assertions_proven: Changed locked threshold/dataset/training receipt and corrupted output refuse; positive four-variant rows retain invalid/abstained denominators.

No executed negative attempts to admit the exact generated engineering artifact as a human-approved deployed model were located; factual absence of a configured real study is not scientific approval.
assertions_proven: CLI artifacts/evidence retain engineering_synthetic, status unvalidated, authority/clinical/history flags false; strict forged approval and rehashed false authority evidence refuse.
